paper_style.palette_strategy: 结果表以浅红至深红 cell fill 表达相对 FULL 的 degradation；方法图以蓝/黄 instruction blocks 与灰/黑流程文字表达 schedule；Figure 1/5/7/8/9/10 使用蓝、黄、绿、橙、红表达 model/setting、success、reference 或 failure。位置、图标、直接标签和线型通常补充颜色，但彩色图在灰度下弱于表格。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF caption、正文、表格规则和大部分表格文字是矢量对象；Figure 1–10 为矢量文本/形状与嵌入栅格或 mixed 图形的组合，Figure 2–4/6/10 以 PDF vector-dominant diagram 呈现，Figure 5/8/9 含 plot-like raster/vector marks。GitHub 仅提供 Figure 1 与 Table 1 的 rendered assets，没有可复用绘图源。
paper_style.style_consistency: Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern math 在正文、caption、表格和公式中稳定；Fira Mono 用于代码/版本/提示片段。图内 DejaVu Sans/无衬线字体和任务图标形成局部视觉层，但表格规则、1 位小数和 grouped headers 在正文与附录基本一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Our simulated conversations for 6 generation tasks on the 15 LLMs observe a major performance drop in multi-turn settings (-39%), explained by some loss in Aptitude, and large loss in Reliability.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝灰背景/点和黄橙背景/点区分 single-turn 与 multi-turn；中心散点连接线、对话框颜色和 green/red outcome glyphs 冗余表达成功与失败；callout 颜色强调 -15% 与 +112%。

encodings.x: 中心散点的 Unreliability；对话面板按 conversation order 从左到右阅读
encodings.y: 中心散点的 Aptitude；对话面板是非数值语境
encodings.color: single-turn/multi-turn 背景与模型点色；success/wrong-answer glyph
encodings.line: 中心点之间的 model transition lines

figures.data_and_statistics: 15 个 LLM、6 个 generation tasks；caption 给出 multi-turn 平均性能下降 39%，图内标示 Aptitude 下降 15% 与 Unreliability 增长 112%。A 是 best-case performance，U 是 90th-minus-10th percentile gap；没有分母、重复或 estimator interval。
figures.evidence_relation: 引言的 evaluation gap → Figure 2 simulator interface → Table 1 matched performance → Figure 5 A/U decomposition → Appendix Figure 7 same-P didactic construction；该图承担 headline 和 mechanism framing，不单独证明真实用户对话。
design_strengths: 实例对话、总体散点和 headline 在一个复合图内闭合。
位置、连接线、背景色、标签和 outcome glyph 形成冗余编码。
与 GitHub teaser 的结构直接对应，适合作为入口图。
design_weaknesses: 中心 chart 与两段对话共享窄高度，模型标签和小字密集。
蓝黄背景和点色在灰度下难以区分。
A/U 的 percentile 定义和 aggregation 不在 caption 中。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用 matched interaction snippets 连接到总体散点位移，并在同一图内命名可操作的机制指标。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Sharded Conversation Simulation Diagram. The simulation subject is highlighted in red.

color.semantic_mapping: 红色框标出被测 assistant；粉/黄/绿路径分别表示 failed answer、non-answer、successful answer；黑色箭头表示控制流。

encodings.x: 从 User Simulator 到 Task Evaluator 的组件顺序
encodings.y: 上方下一轮回路与下方 No more shards/END 回路

figures.data_and_statistics: 方法接口示意；无样本、单位、聚合、分母、重复或数值不确定性。清楚标出 user simulator 持有 shards、assistant 被评估、classifier 触发 extractor/evaluator 的边界。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.2 loop 定义 → §4.2 P/A/U scoring → Table 2 component inspection → Figure 10 concrete trace；这是 method interface，不是结果估计。
design_strengths: 模块角色、控制流和终止条件在一条横向视线内。
顶部三项 outcome legend 与红色 simulation subject 减少角色歧义。
后续 Appendix D 的 inspection rows 能回指图中的组件。
design_weaknesses: outcome 状态主要靠颜色，灰度下区分度下降。
每轮最多一个 shard 和 best-of-attempt scoring 未在图内公式化。
横向模块标签在缩小后偏小。
figures.reusable_pattern: 把 user/environment simulator、被测模型、分类器、答案抽取器和 evaluator 放入同一有向 loop，并把终止条件画成独立回路。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Conversation simulation types based on sharded instructions. Once a fully-specified instruction (blue block) is sharded (yellow blocks), the “shards” can be used to simulate single-turn (FULL, CONCAT) or multi-turn (SHARDED, RECAP, SNOWBALL) conversations, affecting the pace of information disclosure.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝块是 fully-specified instruction，黄块是 shards；块在 6 个 turn 行中的位置表示 disclosure schedule，灰/黑文字标出五种 setting。

encodings.line: 箭头和行/列规则表示 schedule

figures.data_and_statistics: 五种 disclosure schedule 的设计对照；FULL/CONCAT 是 single-turn，SHARDED/RECAP/SNOWBALL 是 multi-turn。没有样本、重复或不确定性，block count 是 schematic。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 sharding definition → §3.2 simulator loop → Figure 4 task instantiation → Table 1 main settings 与 Tables 5/6 mitigation tests。
design_strengths: 统一 block vocabulary 使五种 schedule 可并排比较。
列标题、turn number 和块位置共同编码信息节奏。
caption 明确定义蓝/黄语义和 setting 分组。
design_weaknesses: 块的数量是示意，不是各实验的真实平均 shard 数。
窄 inset 中图标与小字拥挤。
RECAP/SNOWBALL 的操作差异仍需正文解释。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用同一信息块的时序网格同时呈现 baseline、control 和 intervention schedule。

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Six sharded tasks included in our experiments. We include tasks that involve generating programming and natural language. For each task, an illustrative fully-specified instruction and its sharded counterpart. We sharded 90 to 120 instructions based on existing datasets (Instruction Origin), and re-purposing evaluation.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝框表达 fully-specified，黄框表达 sharded；任务图标/任务标题与 PL/NL 分区表达任务类别；灰色横条分隔 instruction 与 source/evaluation 层。

figures.data_and_statistics: 六个 generation tasks；正文称每任务准备 90–120 个 sharded instructions，图展示代表性 examples。底层列出 HumanEval/LiveCodeBench、Spider、BFCL、GSM8K、ToTTo、Summary of a Haystack 和对应 evaluation metrics；没有重复或误差。
figures.evidence_relation: §4.1 task selection → Table 1 six-task result matrix → Appendix J task-specific sample/evaluator → Table 8 translation scope extension。
design_strengths: 六列对齐 original/sharded/source-evaluator，任务异质性可直接扫描。
图标、颜色、PL/NL 分区提供任务类别冗余。
同时公开数据来源和 scoring metric，利于复现。
design_weaknesses: 文本量高，代表性 prompt 在整页缩放时难读。
蓝/黄条件区分在灰度下需要区块标题补充。
没有显示每任务实际样本数差异。
figures.reusable_pattern: 以列对齐的 original/sharded/source-evaluator 三层矩阵绑定任务、输入变换和评分协议。

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: (a) Visual introduction to the concepts of Aptitude and Unreliability when overlaid on a box-plot visualization, (b) reliability results based on experimental simulations with 15 LLMs, (c) summary of results from gradual sharding experiment, with instructions sharded in gradually larger shard sets (from 1 to 8 shards).

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/黄/绿/红填充分别表示 FULL、CONCAT、SHARDED 与 success/failure；box span、P/A/U labels、行位置和模型列共同编码 reliability/degradation。

encodings.x: panel (b) model categories；panel (c) number of shards 1–8；panel (a) simulation grid columns
encodings.line: panel (c) range/whisker marks and dotted explanatory guides
encodings.facet: (a) metric concept、(b) observed model degradations、(c) gradual sharding

figures.data_and_statistics: Panel (a) 是 N=10 instructions、M=10 simulations 的二值教学构造；(b) 是主实验 15 LLM 的 A/U/Performance summary；(c) 是 GPT-4o 与 GPT-4o-mini 在 1–8 shards 的 gradual-sharding subset。A=90th percentile，U=90th−10th percentile；范围不是 estimator confidence interval。
figures.evidence_relation: §4.2 P/A/U definitions → Table 1 cross-model performance → Figure 5b reliability decomposition → Figure 5c shard granularity → Appendix Figure 7 same-P example；definition、measurement 和 stress test 在同一页闭合。
design_strengths: 三 panel 把抽象指标、模型横截面和 shard-count intervention 串联。
A/U/P labels 与小网格使 reliability 机制可见。
模型排序与 Table 1 对齐，便于交叉核对。
design_weaknesses: 三种 panel 的 mark grammar 不完全统一，中央矩阵和右侧小图文字很小。
percentile range 可能被读作 uncertainty interval。
颜色同时承载 setting、success 和 degradation，灰度下信息损失明显。
figures.reusable_pattern: 先用二值网格解释分解指标，再以相同指标连接模型横截面和单一干预轴。

figures.label: Figure 6

caption.text: Figure 6: Process diagram of the four-step semi-automatic process to transform fully-specified instructions into a sharded instruction. The first three steps (segmentation, rephrasing, verification) are automated, while the fourth (inspect and edit) was manually completed by the authors of the work. The last row represents the rejection criteria for a sample.

color.semantic_mapping: 跨五列的文本 highlight 表示 source segment、shard rephrasing、verification outcome 与 manual inspection；黑色底线和垃圾桶图标表示 rejection gate。

encodings.x: 0 Prepare→1 Segmentation→2 Rephrasing→3 Verification→4 Inspection & Edit
encodings.color: highlighted content unit and verification role
encodings.line: stage separators and bottom rejection rules

figures.data_and_statistics: 过程与拒绝条件示意；正文规定前 3 步自动、最后一步人工，且 PConcat≥0.8 PFull、PShuffle-concat≥0.8 PFull。图中没有样本数量或误差。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix C P1–P5 properties → Figure 6 generation/QA gate → Figure 4 sharded examples → Table 2 simulator inspection；支撑 reproduction/interface，不是效果估计。
design_strengths: 同一示例跨阶段，减少抽象 pipeline 的歧义。
自动/人工边界与 rejection thresholds 在图中可见。
底部 gate 将质量控制连接到最终实验样本。
design_weaknesses: 五列文本密集，highlight 颜色在灰度或色觉差异下不稳定。
10x simulation 与 P threshold 的统计含义需正文补充。
没有展示各阶段失败比例。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对半自动数据构造同时显示原文、模型变换、自动验证和人工修订，并在底部固定 rejection criteria。

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7: Illustrations for different situations. Green and red fills in each grid indicate sample-level score (e.g., pass / exact match). Compared to FULL (top left), three situations in SHARDED achieve the same P̄ = 60 while varying in aptitude A and unreliability U.

color.semantic_mapping: 绿色/黄色 check 表示 100 分 success，红色 cross 表示 0 分 failure；grid 位置表达 aptitude 与 reliability 变化，灰色 label strip 写 P/A/U。

encodings.x: 每个 10×10 grid 的 simulation run index
encodings.y: 每个 grid 的 instruction index

figures.data_and_statistics: N=10 instructions、M=10 simulations 的人工二值构造；FULL 为 P=90/A=90/U=0，三个 SHARDED 情形均为 P=60，但 (A,U) 分别为 (60,0)、(90,90)、(80,60)。无抽样误差。
figures.evidence_relation: §4.2 P/A/U estimands → Figure 5 empirical decomposition → Figure 7 non-identifiability teaching case；说明 aggregate P 不能单独识别 aptitude/reliability。
design_strengths: 固定 10×10 网格让三种分解直接逐格比较。
check/cross 与颜色冗余编码成功。
caption 明确同一 P、异 A/U 的教学结论。
design_weaknesses: 二值例子可能被误读为实验观测。
小格 glyph 和 label 需要高分辨率。
continuous metrics 的适用性只能由正文补充。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用同样本量的 outcome matrix 构造同均值异分布例子，展示 aggregate metric 的识别不足。

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: Average length (in number of characters) of answer attempts across four tasks (Code, Database, Data-to-text, and Summary) in SHARDED conversations. Answer attempts in the FULL and CONCAT settings tend to be shorter on average than those from SHARDED setting. SHARDED answer attempts increase in length as the LLMs make more answer attempts.

color.semantic_mapping: 橙色 solid line 是 SHARDED answer length；蓝/绿水平虚线分别是 FULL/CONCAT reference；panel title 表示 task。

encodings.line: solid SHARDED trajectory and dashed reference lines
encodings.text: panel titles and Full/Concat numeric reference labels

figures.data_and_statistics: 四个任务的 extracted answer attempts 平均字符数；SHARDED 多次尝试逐渐变长，FULL/CONCAT 作为 single-turn references。没有 per-attempt sample count、重复或 dispersion。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 2 Answer Extractor → Figure 8 bloat trajectory → Appendix F.2 previous-answer reliance hypothesis → Table 4 response-level verbosity slice；属于 descriptive mechanism evidence。
design_strengths: 统一 x semantics 让四任务行为可横向扫描。
FULL/CONCAT horizontal references 直观给出 bloat 的相对量级。
caption 同时说明对象、setting 和增长方向。
design_weaknesses: 各 panel y range 差异很大，绝对长度不可直接跨任务比较。
只有一条 SHARDED trajectory，无 model/task dispersion。
高 attempt 的有效样本数可能下降但未标出。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将 extracted answer 序号置于横轴，以 single-turn reference lines 展示多轮 answer bloat。

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Analysis of citation patterns in summaries generated by LLMs with the SHARDED simulation. At each turn, the LLM generates an updated summary (y-axis), which includes citations from the documents that have been revealed up to this turn. Percentages in a row do not add up to 100% due to citation hallucinations that occur for some models.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色深浅与 cell percentage 表达 citation proportion；lower-triangular mask 表示该 turn 尚未看见的文档，cell text 直接标数值。

encodings.x: document cited introduced in turn X（1–8）
encodings.text: cell percentages and X/Y axis titles

figures.data_and_statistics: 跨 15 LLM 平均的 summary citation pattern；turn 1 为 96%，turn 2 为 48%/49%，turn 8 对 turn 8 为 20%，中间 turns 多为较低比例。不存在模型层区间或每 cell citation count。
figures.evidence_relation: Summary task in Figure 4 → Appendix F.3 attribution analysis → Figure 9 loss-in-middle-turns claim → limitations 对 model-specific analysis 的保留。
design_strengths: 三角 mask 区分不可见文档与数值为零。
颜色与百分比文字同时表达 magnitude。
caption 主动解释 row-sum anomaly，避免把空白读成零。
design_weaknesses: 无 colorbar，精确颜色到比例的映射只能依靠 cell text。
hallucinated citations 没有单独类别颜色。
半宽图的坐标标签和小百分比较拥挤。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对受 disclosure-time 约束的 attribution 数据使用 lower-triangular matrix，并把不可见区域显式掩蔽。

figures.label: Figure 10

caption.text: Figure 10: Example simulated multi-turn conversation for the Math task. This conversation simulation was with assistant model Llama3.1-8B-Instruct. The sharded instruction consists of six shards. The correct answer to the instruction is 85,000 calories. Each assistant response was classified as an answer attempt in every turn and was evaluated for early success, but none of the generated answers were correct.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅绿 User、浅灰 Assistant、红色 extracted wrong answer/score；turn headings、markdown bold 和列分隔线提供颜色之外的时间结构。

encodings.x: three transcript columns and chronological turn order

figures.data_and_statistics: 单一 Math task trace；assistant 为 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct，六 shards，六次 answer attempt 均被分类但都错误。正确答案 85,000 calories，最终 extracted answer 45,000，Score=0；无总体分母或不确定性。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 2 response classification/extraction → Figure 10 concrete failure trace → Figure 8 answer bloat 与 Appendix F behavior hypotheses；这是 exemplar，不代表 15-model population。
design_strengths: 保留六轮 context，能看到 assumptions、later additions 和错误累计。
turn label、role label、色块和 markdown heading 提供 chronology 冗余。
caption 明确模型、shard 数和正确答案。
design_weaknesses: 文字极密，正文级缩放难以逐字阅读。
单一案例容易被过度外推。
不同轮 extraction 与最终 score 的关系仍需 caption/正文解释。
figures.reusable_pattern: 以固定列宽的 chronology grid 展示完整 failure trace，将 utterance、assistant state 和 evaluator output 放在一条时间轴。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Averaged Performance (P̄) of LLMs on six tasks (Code, Database, Actions, Data-to-text, Math, and Summary). For each task, conversations are simulated in three settings: FULL, CONCAT, and SHARDED. Models are sorted in ascending order of average FULL scores across tasks. Background color indicates the level of degradation from the FULL setting. The last two columns average the performance drops from the CONCAT and SHARDED compared to the FULL in percentages across the six tasks.

tables.uncertainty: No mean±SD, interval, rank uncertainty, or repeated-run dispersion is shown; each cell is an averaged performance P.
tables.data_and_statistics: Each cell is averaged performance P for one model/task/setting; 15 models × 6 tasks × FULL/CONCAT/SHARDED, with two Overall columns for average percentage drops relative to FULL. Models are ordered by average FULL. Per-instruction N=10 and task metric mapping are outside the table in §4.2–§4.3.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 3 schedule definitions → Table 1 matched central matrix → Figure 5 A/U and gradual sharding → Appendix Tables 3/4/7 behavior and temperature slices.
design_strengths: Task and setting are explicit in grouped two-level headers.
Red cell shading provides a fast second channel for degradation.
Overall columns summarize local values without hiding task rows.
design_weaknesses: 21 columns make model/task comparisons dense in a single-column PDF.
Red intensity has no quantitative color scale and weakens in grayscale.
Mapped 0–100 scores hide original metric and denominator unless the reader returns to §4.1.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use matched baseline/control/multi-turn columns plus relative-baseline cell shading and end-of-row summaries.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Results of the manual inspection of 100 simulated SHARDED conversations across four tasks: Actions, Code, Math, and Database. The first column aggregates annotation results on the four tasks.

tables.uncertainty: No interval, standard error, confidence band, or repeat-level uncertainty is reported.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows cover Shard Fully Revealed, Shard Contextualized, Strategy Accuracy, Extraction Success, and Overall Success; columns are All Tasks plus Actions/Code/Math/Db. The caption says 100 inspected conversations, while Appendix D prose says 200, leaving the denominator internally inconsistent.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 2 simulator components → Table 2 manual inspection → §3.2 simulator accuracy claim; it supports pipeline QA but not real-user validation.
design_strengths: Component-level and conversation-level checks share one compact table.
All Tasks and task slices expose local Code/Math differences.
Row groups mirror the user/assistant/overall stages in Figure 2.
design_weaknesses: Caption denominator 100 conflicts with prose denominator 200.
Pale red fill has no explicit quantitative legend.
Long inspection labels and small type increase scan cost.
tables.reusable_pattern: Group QA rows by pipeline stage and retain an aggregate column next to task-specific slices.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Averaged performance (P̄) breakdown, based on how early in the conversation the LLM makes its first answer attempt. Analysis conducted on simulations of two tasks: Code and Math.

tables.uncertainty: No per-bin denominator, interval, or repeat-level uncertainty is given.
tables.data_and_statistics: Fifteen model rows plus Average are crossed with five first-answer timing bins. Average P rises from 30.9 in 0–20% to 64.4 in 80–100%; analysis covers only Code and Math.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix F behavior analysis → Table 3 premature-answer association → Figure 8 answer bloat and Figure 9 citation-position analysis; this is a descriptive slice, not an intervention.
design_strengths: Model order matches Table 1 for cross-object scanning.
Two header rows map percentage bins to earliest/early/midway/late/latest.
Blue sequential fill makes the timing gradient visible.
design_weaknesses: Bin sample sizes are absent and can differ by model.
No colorbar maps fill to P.
Caption omits the observed later-is-higher direction.
tables.reusable_pattern: Discretize behavior timing into semantic bins, preserve model rows and an average row, and label the analysis subset.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Averaged performance (P̄) of LLMs on the six experimental tasks, arranged based on model relative verbosity (length of response). Performance degrades when models generate longer responses on five of the six tasks.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty or interval; quintile cells are point averages.
tables.data_and_statistics: Seven data rows (six tasks plus Average) are arranged by five response-length quintiles; each (model,instruction) tuple contributes two simulations per quintile. Five tasks decline left-to-right; Actions is the exception.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 8 answer bloat → Table 4 full-response verbosity association → §F.4 hypothesis about assumptions and confusion; the binned association is not a causal intervention.
design_strengths: Task rows and quintile columns are regular and easy to scan.
Second header row makes percentile direction explicit.
Color, values, and Average row provide redundant summary paths.
design_weaknesses: Caption omits the two-simulation allocation and task normalization.
No colorbar; shade is not an effect-size scale.
Observation-based bins can be mistaken for interventions.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use semantic behavior quintiles with task rows and an overall row while preserving direction-reversing exceptions.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Experimental Results with additional simulation types: Recap and Snowball. Both strategies involve repeating user-turn information to mitigate models getting lost in conversations.

tables.uncertainty: No N, repetition count, interval, or dispersion is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two models (4o-mini, 4o) are compared across FULL, CONCAT, SHARDED, RECAP, and SNOWBALL average performance columns. Recap is above Snowball but both remain below FULL/CONCAT while improving over SHARDED.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 3 schedule definitions → Table 5 repetition interventions → §G.1 agent-style mitigation conclusion; values cover a four-task subset.
design_strengths: One row per model keeps baseline/control/intervention comparison compact.
Simulation icons reuse the paper-wide vocabulary.
The table shows “improvement but not recovery” without extra prose.
design_weaknesses: Icon-only columns are difficult to decode in isolation.
Red fill has no explicit direction legend.
No uncertainty or sample-size information accompanies small differences.
tables.reusable_pattern: Add intervention columns to a matched baseline table while keeping model and metric fixed.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6: Comparing performance in SHARDED conversations of GPT-4o given no system prompt (default) vs. providing a specialized system prompt hinting that the conversation will likely be underspecified. Results reported on four tasks: Math, Actions, Database, and Code.

tables.uncertainty: No interval, repeat count, or uncertainty column is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: GPT-4o SHARDED scores are shown for default versus specialized system prompt across Math, Actions, Database, Code and Avg.; Avg. changes from 59.1 to 60.2, with task-specific increases and an Actions decrease.
tables.evidence_relation: §G.1 prompt intervention → Table 6 task-level result → conclusion that the hint changes behavior but does not prevent getting lost; this is a narrow ablation.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先给 headline 与 Aptitude/Unreliability framing；Figure 2–4 定义 simulator、五种 disclosure schedules 和六任务 matched construction；Table 1 与 Figure 5 在 p.7 组成 central evidence block；Appendix Figure 6/7 与 Table 2 验证 sharding/simulator 和 P/A/U 识别；Figure 8/9 与 Tables 3/4 展开 post-hoc behavior analyses；Tables 5–8 测试 repetition、system prompt、temperature 和 episodic-task boundary；Tables 9/10 与 Figure 10 负责 taxonomy、access reproducibility 和 failure trace。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 1/5/7/8/9/10 的 caption 包含 headline 或机制方向；Figure 2–4/6 主要说明 setup 和 encoding；Table 1–4/7 解释条件、分组和比较，Table 5/6 指明 intervention，Table 8–10 偏向 scope、taxonomy 和 metadata。多数 caption 自包含，但图标、A/U 定义和 Table 2 denominator 仍需正文。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1/3/4/5/7 使用多层 grouped headers 表示 setting、model、timing 或 verbosity；Table 2/6/8 以 task/model group 组织窄表；Table 9/10 使用平面定义/metadata headers。booktabs 横线、1 位小数和 cell shading 构成跨对象规则，缺失值或非数值对象不用伪造的 zero。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 3 的 schedule → Figure 4 的 task construction → Table 1 的 FULL/CONCAT/SHARDED main comparison → Figure 5 的 A/U 与 shard-count stress test → Appendix Tables 5–8 的 mitigation/scope。Figure 2/6/9/10 将 simulator、classifier、extraction 和 behavior evidence 连接到结果，但 post-hoc slices 仍不构成干预识别。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文保留 Figure 1–5 与 Table 1，使 headline、方法接口、任务覆盖和 central matrix 可独立阅读；附录承载 simulator QA、didactic decomposition、mechanism slices、mitigations、translation negative result、model access 和 qualitative trace。Figure 5c/Appendix L、Table 7/Appendix M、Table 5/Appendix N 之间有明确调用。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文/caption/table 共享 Nimbus Roman No9 L，公式共享 Computer Modern math，代码和模型版本局部使用 Fira Mono；图内无衬线字体略有差异，但字号层级（caption 大于图内标签、表格数值较小）稳定。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 浅红普遍表示 degradation/unreliability，蓝/黄主要表示 fully-specified/sharded instruction，绿色表示 success，橙/蓝/绿虚线表示 setting/reference。图内颜色多数有位置、文字或符号补充，但 Figure 1/5/6/10 的混合语义使灰度复核弱于黑白表格。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 3 用 block schedule 固定 baseline、control 和 multi-turn intervention。
Figure 4 用 original/sharded/source-evaluator 六列矩阵绑定任务、变换和评分。
Table 1 用 setting×task grouped matrix 和 relative-baseline shading 承载主效应。
Figure 5 将 metric definition、模型横截面和 shard-count stress test 串成 definition→measurement→stress-test 链。
附录以 taxonomy、metadata 和完整 failure trace 支撑复现而不把 exemplar 当作总体估计。
highest_value_objects: Figure 4：任务与 evaluator 的可复核接口。
failure_patterns: Table 1、Figure 5 和 Figure 10 在单栏页面中信息密度高，小字与多层编码增加复核成本。
大多数性能对象没有分母、重复或 dispersion；彩色 fill/path 在灰度下退化。
Table 2 caption 的 100 与 Appendix D prose 的 200 inspection denominator 冲突。
Figure 5 的 percentile range 可能被误读为 estimator uncertainty，Appendix F 的 timing/verbosity/citation 分箱是 association 而非因果机制。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文先用 matched conversation diagram 与 instruction blocks 定义信息披露节奏，再以多层性能矩阵证明 multi-turn degradation，最后用 A/U、行为切片、缓解实验和附录 failure trace 将 headline 限定在 controlled underspecification stress test 的范围内。
